integrity.safety: All 70 entries verified; no extraction/import/execution of archive code.

identity_rules: One row per distinct full ID; repeated references and shared classes are merged.
Components have only local numeric IDs: COMPONENT-<source number>.
Module source names are preserved under MODULE:<exact source name>.
WDA §21 local V1..V6 IDs are qualified as WDA-CF-1:V1..V6.

Edge identities come from file01 $.edge_contracts[*].candidate_id: 42 exact D03-SRC/ADD/MST IDs. They are distinct from the 80 POS/NEG oracle IDs, which are preserved as their own shared D03-test IDs.
Negative-case identities come from file02 $.negative_cases[*].negative_id: 84 actual IDs. Amendment 1 checks aggregate counts only; no per-ID preserved/derived provenance is classified or inferred.

No authoritative ID field value matches literal ^EDGE-[0-9]+$ or ^NEG-[0-9]+$. R3's EDGE-/NEG- family wording is not their actual namespace. Original full IDs are preserved; no bare EDGE-/NEG- IDs are manufactured.
ATC document version IDs are not test IDs. T/C requirements, X tests and I integration oracle rows are included; J owner rows come from member05.
V3WDA oracle rows and six named canonical vectors are included. Historical WDA versions, review-finding IDs and anonymous rejection cases are not new IDs.
Inherited G1R IDs are full numeric-unit/single-letter IDs in MASTER and EXT, not slice labels, family shorthand or invented range expansions.
Original decision columns and byte-faithful CSV records are retained in provenance.
overlap_explanation: All 80 edge oracle IDs and all 84 negative_case IDs also occur as D03 test IDs. They each have one universe row with multiple classes. The 42 D03 candidate_id values are separate edge-identity rows.

negative_case.controlled_count_rule: Amendment 1 §2(a–d): exact own aggregate fields 59/25, 84 distinct IDs, independent 38 guarded/84 denied pairs and exact ID/pair bijection; no per-ID preserved/derived inference.

identifier_field_evidence.correction: Earlier generator incorrectly compared 80 edge oracle IDs against 42 edge identities and omitted 42 candidate IDs. Corrected universe includes all 42 exact candidate IDs and all 84 exact negative IDs, merged only when the complete ID string is identical to a D03 test ID.

status_vocabulary_conflicts.explanation: The five final statuses have no honest pending value. Pending rows retain empty final_status and explicit implementation_state. They are not approval blockers, final dispositions, or TEST_PASS.

graph_verification.method: Derive each axis enum from file01 from/to states; Cartesian (enum × (enum minus ∅)); subtract only individually GUARDED candidate pairs. Compare resulting complement against every file02 negative_cases row.

runtime_evidence_boundary.context_only: A1 metadata loader and UTC ReplayClock: 77 tests, 175 statements, 70 branches. Not requirement-level completion evidence. No A2/uncommitted or future B–G result is inferred.
runtime_evidence_boundary.pending_semantics: NOT_IMPLEMENTED means no full requirement-level implementation has been mapped and proven here; it does not deny existing partial A1 work.

blocker_record_boundary: Only assigned script/CSV/report paths are writable for this deliverable. Parent must mirror source conflicts into evidence/BLOCKED_REQUIREMENTS.md as R3 §4 requests; this generator does not modify that shared file.

validation.success_requires: Current artifacts, no source conflicts, no pending mappings.

source_counts.success_requires: Current artifacts, source integrity, exact extraction counts and one traceability row per universe ID. Honest pending mappings are allowed.

exit_codes.0: Requested gate passed; source-count mode permits pending mappings
exit_codes.2: Source-count conflict, or pending completeness in --check/--write only
